name: hirale/openmage-ga4-measurement
description: Server-side Google Analytics 4 events for OpenMage and Maho, dispatching through core Maho_Queue on Maho and hirale/queue on OpenMage.

suggest.googleads/data-manager: ^0.4 — required only by the Data Manager API transport; the default Measurement Protocol transport needs nothing beyond ext-curl
suggest.hirale/queue: ^3.0 — the queue backend on OpenMage; required there, unused on Maho, which dispatches through the core Maho_Queue module
suggest.magento-hackathon/magento-composer-insta: Deploys extra.map into the OpenMage project (resolves at 1.3.2; see the hirale/queue README — Maho needs no installer plugin)
suggest.ext-protobuf: Faster protobuf encoding for the Data Manager API transport (pure PHP works without it; ext-grpc is not needed — the module uses the REST transport)
